title: Your local browser agent
description: Draft ideas, prepare content and complete approved form workflows on your own computer.
privacy: The app runs on your device with a local model. Drafts, browser profiles and approval history stay on that device.
approval: Review the exact destination and content before approving an action. The model cannot approve its own proposals.
setup: Install Fleetwright and a supported local model using the setup guide.
Start the local app, then open it with the button below.
Choose a task, inspect its draft and approve only the action you intend.
features: Bounded browser tabs and action budgets
offline: The hosted console does not access your local browser. Start the local app before opening it.
